bug_description.normalized: The fuzz harness memcpy-copies attacker-controlled bytes into a `NeAACDecConfiguration` and short decode buffers. The first FAAD2-side consumption on the crashing path is `NeAACDecSetConfiguration()`, which validates that `defObjectType` is decodable and `defSampleRate` is nonzero, then stores those attacker-controlled fields into `hDecoder->config`. Because the witness has `flags == 0`, `NeAACDecInit()` later derives an LD `object_type` and a sampling-frequency index whose LD 512-window `num_swb` table entry is 0. During the later raw AAC frame decode, the saved MSan stack proves `raw_data_block()` reaches the error-resilience `decode_cpe()` call site, and `ics_info()` materializes `window_sequence == ONLY_LONG_SEQUENCE` together with `max_sfb == 0`. `window_grouping_info()` therefore sets `ics1->num_swb = 0`; its `max_sfb > num_swb` guard sees `0 > 0` false, and `ics_info()` immediately repeats the same predicate and also sees `0 > 0` false, so the zero-band ICS state survives both gates. `reconstruct_channel_pair()` allocates stack arrays `spec_coef1` and `spec_coef2` and calls `quant_to_spec()` on them, but vulnerable `quant_to_spec()` only writes `spec_data` inside `for (sfb = 0; sfb < ics->num_swb; sfb++)`. With `num_swb == 0`, that loop executes zero iterations and leaves `spec_coef1` uninitialized. `ifilter_bank()` / `faad_imdct()` then consume that poisoned spectral buffer and propagate uninitialized values into `time_out` and `fb_intermed`. Because LD is treated as an LTP object, `reconstruct_channel_pair()` calls `lt_update_state()`, which passes `time[i]` into `real_to_int16()`. MemorySanitizer reports the use-of-uninitialized-value at the branch `if (sig_in >= 0)` in `real_to_int16()`. The fixing commit adds `if (ics->num_swb == 0) memset(spec_data, 0, frame_len * sizeof(real_t));` before the fill loops in `quant_to_spec()`, satisfying the missing initialization obligation.

source.description: First FAAD2-side consumption of the fuzzed configuration. `NeAACDecSetConfiguration()` validates the attacker-controlled default object type and sample rate, then copies them into `hDecoder->config`, creating the decoder state later transformed by `NeAACDecInit()` into `object_type`, `sf_index`, and the LD zero-`num_swb` path.
source.value_from: The staged 31-byte witness begins `01 00 01 00 00`, so `fuzz_decode` sets `len1 = 1`, `len2 = 1`, `flags = 0`, memcpy-copies the next `sizeof(NeAACDecConfiguration)` bytes into `config`, and calls `NeAACDecSetConfiguration()`. The first copied config byte is `0x17`, so `config->defObjectType` is `LD (23)`; the copied `defSampleRate` field is nonzero, so lines 205-212 accept and store both fields in `hDecoder->config`.

tainted_value_origin.description: MemorySanitizer origin. `spec_coef1` is the first-channel stack spectral buffer allocated without initialization in `reconstruct_channel_pair()`. When `quant_to_spec()` skips all writes for `num_swb == 0`, later stages read this untouched stack storage.
tainted_value_origin.value_from: The saved MSan trace states: "Uninitialized value was created by an allocation of 'spec_coef1' in the stack frame of function 'reconstruct_channel_pair'" at `libfaad/specrec.c:1122`.

sink.description: MemorySanitizer crash site. `real_to_int16()` branches on the uninitialized `sig_in` value passed from `lt_update_state(time[i])`.
sink.note: Both `default_crash_trace.txt` and `sanitizer_trace.txt` report `MemorySanitizer: use-of-uninitialized-value` at `libfaad/lt_predict.c:154:9` with stack `real_to_int16 -> lt_update_state -> reconstruct_channel_pair -> channel_pair_element -> decode_cpe`.

root_cause.description: Root cause. In vulnerable `quant_to_spec()`, the only writes to `spec_data` happen inside the `sfb < num_swb` loop. When the parsed ICS state makes `ics->num_swb == 0`, the loop executes zero iterations and leaves the destination buffer uninitialized.
root_cause.note: The fixing commit inserts `if (ics->num_swb == 0) memset(spec_data, 0, frame_len * sizeof(real_t));` before the loops, confirming that the missing obligation is initialization of `spec_data` when the zero-band state is accepted.

parser_admitted.description: The saved crash stack proves the witness passed FAAD2's init/header dispatch and entered the error-resilience raw AAC parser far enough to decode a channel-pair element before spectral reconstruction.

coarse_trace.summary: The fuzzed decoder configuration is first validated and copied into `hDecoder->config`, then `NeAACDecInit()` derives LD `object_type`, an `sf_index` selecting a zero-band LD table entry, and a 512-sample LD frame length.

The crashing raw AAC frame is parsed as an ER channel-pair element. Its ICS header yields `ONLY_LONG_SEQUENCE` and `max_sfb == 0`, `window_grouping_info()` materializes `num_swb == 0`, and both `max_sfb > num_swb` range checks evaluate `0 > 0` false so the zero-band state is accepted.

The stack buffer `spec_coef1[1024]` is passed to `quant_to_spec()`, but the zero-band state skips the only fill loop so the buffer remains uninitialized; `ifilter_bank()` / `faad_imdct()` then propagate those poisoned coefficients into `time_out` and `fb_intermed`.
Because LD is treated as an LTP object, `lt_update_state()` converts the poisoned `time[i]` sample through `real_to_int16()`, and MSan reports the branch on uninitialized `sig_in`.

fine_trace.note: Source. `NeAACDecSetConfiguration()` is the first FAAD2-side consumption of the fuzzed config. It accepts `config->defObjectType == LD` via `can_decode_ot()` and a nonzero `config->defSampleRate`, then copies both attacker-controlled fields into `hDecoder->config` for later init.

`NeAACDecInit()` transforms step 1's saved configuration into live decode state. On the crashing path it reuses the stored LD object type and derives an `sf_index` whose LD 512-window table entry is 0.
Because step 2 selected LD, init halves the default 1024-sample frame length to 512. The later long-window grouping logic therefore uses the LD 512-sample scalefactor-band table.

Because step 2 made `object_type >= ER_OBJECT_START`, `raw_data_block()` takes the error-resilience branch. The saved crash stack reaches its `case 2: decode_cpe(...)` call site at line 556, so the current payload is parsed as a channel-pair element; channel-configuration plumbing is not expanded because it adds no new vulnerability-relevant state.

The CPE's ICS header is parsed from the attacker-controlled AAC payload. On the crashing path it materializes `ONLY_LONG_SEQUENCE`, selecting the long-window grouping logic and the `ONLY_LONG_SEQUENCE` branch later used by `ifilter_bank()`.

Because step 5 did not choose short windows, `ics_info()` reads the long-block `max_sfb` field here. On the crashing path it becomes 0, matching the zero-band condition later checked twice against `num_swb`.

In the LD long-window case, `window_grouping_info()` selects the LD `num_swb` table using step 2's sampling-frequency index and step 3's frame length. On the crashing path the chosen table entry is 0, so this channel has zero scalefactor window bands.
This is the first zero-band gate. With step 6's `max_sfb == 0` and step 7's `num_swb == 0`, the predicate is false, so `window_grouping_info()` returns success instead of rejecting the state.
After step 8 returns, `ics_info()` immediately repeats the same `max_sfb > num_swb` check. It again sees `0 > 0` false, so the zero-band ICS survives the second gate and returns to decoding.

fine_trace.code: retval = quant_to_spec(hDecoder, ics1, spec_data1, spec_coef1, hDecoder->frameLength);
fine_trace.note: The first channel's stack-local spectral buffer `spec_coef1[1024]` (the MSan origin) is passed into `quant_to_spec()` as the destination that should be filled with dequantized spectral coefficients.

Root cause. The only writes to `spec_data` occur inside this loop. Because step 7 made `ics->num_swb == 0`, the loop executes zero iterations, so `spec_coef1` stays uninitialized. The patch adds an explicit zeroing fast-path before the loops for exactly this case.

fine_trace.code:
ifilter_bank(hDecoder->fb, ics1->window_sequence, ics1->window_shape,
    hDecoder->window_shape_prev[cpe->channel], spec_coef1,
    hDecoder->time_out[cpe->channel], hDecoder->fb_intermed[cpe->channel],
    hDecoder->object_type, hDecoder->frameLength);
fine_trace.note: The still-poisoned `spec_coef1` array is fed into `ifilter_bank()`. In the saved MSan report, `faad_imdct()` / `ComplexMult()` under this call site store uninitialized-derived values to memory, and the filter-bank windowing writes them into `time_out` and `fb_intermed` for the channel.
LD counts as an LTP object type, so reconstruct_channel_pair enters this block and passes the poisoned `time_out` and `fb_intermed` channel buffers into `lt_update_state()`.

In the LD-specific update loop, `lt_update_state()` converts the current channel sample through `real_to_int16()`. This passes the uninitialized `time[i]` value from step 12 as the helper's `sig_in` argument.
Sink. MemorySanitizer reports the exact use-of-uninitialized-value here: the helper branches on the indeterminate `sig_in` value loaded from `time[i]` in step 14.

allocation_context.note: The sanitizer trace reports the origin as the allocation of `spec_coef1` in the `reconstruct_channel_pair` stack frame at line 1122; the actual declaration is line 1124.

sanitizer_ground_truth.source: parsed from staged default_crash_trace.txt / sanitizer_trace.txt / patch.diff

cross_validation.root_cause_matches_allocation_context: The allocation context names `spec_coef1` as the poisoned stack object; the root cause is the later missing initialization in `quant_to_spec()` that leaves that object untouched when `ics->num_swb == 0`.
cross_validation.patch_resolves_note: The fixing diff adds `if (ics->num_swb == 0) memset(spec_data, 0, frame_len * sizeof(real_t));` before the dequantization loops in `quant_to_spec()`, which directly initializes the stack spectral buffer that later reaches `ifilter_bank()` and `real_to_int16()`.

poc.trigger: Stage 01's authoritative runtime evidence is `default_crash_trace.txt` / `sanitizer_trace.txt`, captured from the stock vulnerable image and summarized in `reproduction_report.json`. Those saved traces show `MemorySanitizer: use-of-uninitialized-value` at `real_to_int16` with stack `lt_update_state -> reconstruct_channel_pair -> channel_pair_element -> decode_cpe`. The later local rebuild lost MSan fidelity and only reproduced a raw SIGSEGV, so the saved MSan traces remain the runtime source of truth for Stage 02.

format.name: binary fuzz_decode witness
format.contract: Exactly the staged 31-byte file with SHA-256 `d499510efc5b17cdb9c4c54ae2aed234f809349a7a0ba745260eb56fc074bb08`. `fuzz_decode` interprets bytes 0-1 as `len1 = 1`, bytes 2-3 as `len2 = 1`, byte 4 as `flags = 0` (so it uses `NeAACDecInit()`), memcpy-copies the next `sizeof(NeAACDecConfiguration)` bytes into the decoder configuration, and then feeds the remaining split buffers to `NeAACDecDecode()`. Stage 01 proves that this exact witness reaches the LD `num_swb == 0` spectral-reconstruction path and reproduces the saved MSan crash; this contract does not generalize to other AAC bitstreams or other fuzzed preambles.
